title: Keep explicit test-history pagination progress visible and announced without shifting the panel
outcome: Loading an older page or retrying its failed continuation has an in-place visible and accessible progress indication while revision refresh keeps the current layout stable.
acceptance: A deferred Load older read and an explicit retry of a failed continuation expose visible and announced progress without moving the history list; rows remain visible.
Revision refresh remains free of the loading-line layout jump; first load, errors and empty results remain clear, with no new query or retry mechanism.
